title: Maven Grace - Lone Star
htmlContent:
Maven Grace released a new single, "Lone Star," a follow-up to his recently released single "Lost Souls." A straightforward but well-done production that gives him a perfect stage to show off his range and charm.

The single "Lone Star" is demonstrated through his storytelling, underlined as a sense of hope and empowerment. His newest song 'Lone Star' delivers steamy lines over a friendly instrumental. Wordplay, delivery, and tone combined to make a unique style. 

Stream Maven Grace's "Lone Star" on Spotify.
